audit_metadata.title: Nyaya Saathi Legal Knowledge Base Inventory Audit

nyaya_saathi_current_law.description: In-force statutory law (CPA 2019, 2020 Rules, Corrigendum, 2021 Amendment)

discrepancy_reconciliation.explanation_206_vs_251: 206 is the count of canonical parent chunks in legal_chunks.json. 25 of those parent chunks exceeded token thresholds and were segmented into 70 child segments. The 181 unchunked parents plus 70 child segments yield exactly 251 active embedding records in embedding_records.json and ChromaDB.
discrepancy_reconciliation.explanation_251_vs_276: 276 is the union of unique IDs in both files: 181 unchunked parent chunk IDs + 25 split parent chunk IDs (retained in legal_chunks.json) + 70 child segment IDs (in embedding_records.json) = 276 unique active identifiers.
discrepancy_reconciliation.explanation_276_vs_350: Adding the 74 isolated historical reference chunks (from CONSUMER_HANDBOOK_2015.pdf, retrieval_eligible=False) to the 276 active identifiers gives exactly 350 total unique legal knowledge-base identifiers across the repository.
discrepancy_reconciliation.explanation_earlier_reporting_discrepanc: An earlier narrative informally grouped chunks into '141 CPA 2019, 64 E-Commerce Rules, 1 Amendment'. That narrative conflated CDRC Rules (17), General Rules (5), Jurisdiction Rules (5), E-Commerce Rules (8), Corrigendum (1), and Amendments into a single 'E-Commerce / Rules' shorthand, while misattributing the CPA chunk count. The actual verified physical breakdown across legal_chunks.json is: CPA 2019: 154; CDRC Rules: 17; e-Jagriti Guide: 13; E-Commerce Rules 2020: 8; General Rules 2020: 5; Jurisdiction Rules 2021: 5; E-Commerce Amendment 2026: 2; E-Commerce Amendment 2021: 1; E-Commerce Corrigendum 2020: 1. Total = 206.
discrepancy_reconciliation.explanation_ejagriti_1_vs_13: The '1 e-Jagriti guide' referred to 1 logical document entity in source_catalog.json, which extracts into exactly 13 canonical chunks in legal_chunks.json and 13 records in embedding_records.json.
